title: Early childhood development, World
headline: For all 35 countries with data on early childhood development, the latest is from after 2020
subtitle: The recommended measure for SDG 4.2.1 is the Early Childhood Development Index 2030 (ECDI2030) which is a 20-item instrument to measure developmental outcomes among children aged 24 to 59 months in population-based surveys.
data_line: Data: UNICEF via UN SDG Global Database, series SE_DEV_ONTRK, SE_DEV_ONTRKWB, extracted 1 Nov 2026
flags: acronym shown without a definition: ECDI2030
alt: For all 35 countries with data on early childhood development, the latest is from after 2020. Latest values 2021 to 2025; median year 2023. Countries by year of their latest value on early childhood development: 35 in all, 0 in 2020 or earlier.
method: Method: latest value per country; 2020 or earlier is not recent.
question: Which countries have found a way to measure early childhood development more often, and what made it possible?
